{{Quote|For centuries, Alderaan stood as a beacon of hope in the Republic. But the Empire came, and with one savage strike, brought Alderaan to her knees. Now, time is running out, as few are left to face the enemy. For those that remain, there is but one choice. We must fight—to victory, or death—for the Republic!|Captain Jace Malcom|audio=BattleOfAlderaan-TORHope.flac|<ref name="Hope" />}}
The '''Battle of Alderaan''' was a major conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that occurred at the height of the [[Great Galactic War]], in [[3667 BBY]]. The peaceful and verdant [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was a [[Core Founder/Legends|founding member]] of the Republic and widely viewed as an embodiment of the ideals and principles upon which the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government was founded. It was that reputation that made it a military target for the Sith Empire. As the Great Galactic War dragged on elsewhere in the galaxy, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] formulated a plan to crush Republic morale by invading Alderaan and shattering its fabled serenity. The incursion was led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], who planned for it to coincide with a diversionary feint that would pull the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] far from Alderaan. As the planet sat undefended by the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], it was beset by a massive Sith invasion force that [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the planet from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], obliterated its local defense forces, and took the Alderaanian [[House Panteer|royal family]] hostage. Malgus and his forces burned entire cities to the ground and brutalized the peaceful noble families, all the while the small number of Jedi who were onworld at the time of the invasion struggled to make even the slightest dent in the Sith invasion force.

Unknown to the Sith forces, however, groups of [[Republic trooper]]s returning from battles in the Outer Rim were stationed across the planet's surface prior to the invasion. These [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] banded together and took to the forests of Alderaan's [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] during the Sith attack and proceeded to wage a guerrilla war against the enemy. As Darth Malgus led his forces in a march toward the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], he was ambushed by the troopers of [[Republic Special Forces Division]]' [[Havoc Squad]]. Much of the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle, but with the timely arrival of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] to aid the men of Havoc Squad, Malgus and his Sith forces were routed. Following the skirmish outside the city, the Republic fleet returned from the diversionary feint to drive the Empire off of Alderaan. The battle was a major victory for the Republic, but had grave consequences for the future of Alderaan. Although historically a voice for peace, the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] government became a vocal proponent of harsh military actions against the Empire in the aftermath of the battle. This new stance came into conflict with the peace established by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], which ultimately led to a [[Alderaan Civil War|bloody planetary civil war]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|While Coruscant has always been considered the heart of the Republic, to some extent, Alderaan has been its soul.|A [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] dossier on Alderaan|<ref name="Alderaan" />}}
[[File:BattlefieldAlderaan-TORHope.png|thumb|left|270px|The Empire's Alderaan staging ground.]]
After its return to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] prominence in [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="WarStart">According to ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'', the [[Great Galactic War]] begins twenty-eight years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Treaty was proposed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]], as seen in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.</ref> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stabbed into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in a brutal campaign for domination.<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> As the [[Great Galactic War]] dragged on, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] seized much of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and continued to advance toward the Republic's bastion [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] near the galaxy's center, known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Despite two [[First Battle of Bothawui|major]] [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|setbacks]] at the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]<ref name="Timeline 5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> in [[3671 BBY]],<ref name="BoBDate">According to ''[[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui]]'', this conflict occurs eighteen years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Treaty was proposed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]], as seen in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''.</ref> the Empire continued to press their offensive in the hope of ending the war quickly.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> The Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] also sought to take revenge on the Republic for the [[Capture of the Dread Masters|capture]] of the six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] a [[3668 BBY|year earlier]], as the loss of the Dread Masters' power angered the Council.<ref name="Datacron 89">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Galactic History 89: Capturing the Dread Masters}}</ref> To that end, the Core Worlds became an even greater focus, and in this region lay [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a verdant and historically tranquil planet that had long been a voice for peace in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Alderaan was seen as the soul of the principles the Republic had been founded on, and it was that reputation that made it a military target for opportunistic Sith [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] hoping to capitalize on what had the potential to be a major blow to Republic morale.<ref name="Alderaan" />

The plan for an Imperial invasion of Alderaan was headed by the Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]], who had recently been granted the honorific title of "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]." Malgus specialized in surprise assaults and utilized that ability in planning the attack on Alderaan.<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> In [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Sith Lord manipulated the forces of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] into all but abandoning the planet in order to deal with a situation [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] away—a situation that was in fact nothing more than a diversionary feint fabricated by Malgus to pull defenses away from his target.<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> Unbeknownst to the Sith, however, a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]—including [[Satele Shan]],<ref name="JoMGD" />—were on the planet to investigate rumors of Imperial interference in the [[Politics/Legends|politics]] of the ruling [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families. Additionally, many [[Republic trooper|troopers]] from the [[Republic Army]], specifically the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] division, were on Alderaan, for the peaceful Core World served as a rest and medical recuperation center for soldiers returning from brutal battlefronts across the Mid and Outer Rims.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==The battle==
===War comes to Alderaan===
{{Quote|There were Jedi and at least one squad of Republic Special Forces on the planet, but we have had no contact with them since the attack began. If all these reports are true, I fear we are far too late to make a difference and that Alderaan is already lost.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, expressing his fears while aboard a Republic naval vessel rushing to aid Alderaan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
With Alderaan's naval defenses far from their charge, the forces of the Empire invaded the world in a swift and savage assault.<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> Prior to landing their [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], the Empire initiated a heavy [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the world, which decimated a number of townships and filled much of the atmosphere with ash and thick black smoke.<ref name="Third Lesson" /> Darth Malgus himself led the incursion force, which consisted of several thousand [[Sith war droid Mark I|assault droids]], hundreds of fellow Sith,<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> large numbers of [[Imperial soldier]]s, and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> The ground forces were joined by vessels of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], including [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighters]] and [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]]. Once his forces were on the surface, Malgus began a devastating campaign across the once-tranquil world. The Sith forces obliterated the local [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] defense forces and went on to burn entire [[City/Legends|cities]] to the ground.<ref name="Hope" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] participated in the conflicts on the planet,<ref name="ToR:Deceived" /> alongside Knights Satele Shan,<ref name="JoMGD" /> [[Warren Sedoru]],<ref name="Warren" /> and other Jedi defenders.<ref name="Third Lesson" />

[[File:BattleOfAlderaan-TORHope.png|thumb|right|270px|Republic forces engage the Imperials in their guerrilla war.]]
Upon learning that the Empire had come to Alderaan, Satele Shan rushed to ensure the safety of the Alderaanian [[Queen/Legends|Queen]]<ref name="JoMGD" /> [[Silara Panteer]].<ref name="Silara">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Sudden Death|Alderaan. In-game conversations with [[Katei Elinari Panteer|Katei Panteer]] reveal the Panteer Queen to be [[Silara Panteer]]. Prior to the release of the game, the queen's name was not known}}</ref> However, upon arriving at [[Castle Panteer]], she found the building in ruins—the Imperials had already captured the [[House Panteer|royal family]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> The Sith held the Panteer royals hostage throughout their invasion, earning the ire of the Alderaanian government and people.<ref name="Alderaan" /> They also targeted and brutalized [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], Alderaan's most Republic-friendly noble family.<ref name="Organa">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Organa}}</ref> Although other Jedi attempted to push back against the invaders, their efforts were easily swatted down. Sedoru was critically injured in the fighting,<ref name="Warren" /> while others took to hiding in ruined cities in the hope of ambushing a lone enemy.<ref name="Third Lesson" /> After learning that she would be unable to help protect the Queen,<ref name="JoMGD" /> Shan had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] that Jace Malcom, whom she had fought alongside previously, would need her aid, and contacted the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on<ref name="Annihilation" /> the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to request reinforcements.<ref name="Annihilation" /> Word began to spread of the Empire's attack, and although Republic forces rallied to strike back, it was widely accepted that the battle had already been lost—Alderaan had fallen to the Sith.<ref name="JoMGD" />

As Malgus continued his brutal campaign across the planet, he set his sights on Alderaan's planetary capital city<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> and [[Castle Organa]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> While he led his forces in a march toward the city through the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]],<ref name="Juran">{{TORcite|type=codex|Juran Mountains}}</ref> the Republic forces that had been stationed on Alderaan's surface mobilized. Up until the Sith advance on the capital, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the Republic Military had been recovering from the wounds of battle and awaiting orders from their superiors.<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> In response to Malgus's overtures, they took to Alderaan's forests and mountain ranges in preparation to fight a guerrilla counter-campaign against the Sith invaders.<ref name="BofA">{{TORcite|type=codex|Battle of Alderaan}}</ref> While the rest of the Republic personnel on the planet set out to repel the Sith across Alderaan, it fell to the elite Special Forces group [[Havoc Squad]] to defend the capital and Castle Organa by engaging the Imperial forces under the direct command of Darth Malgus.<ref name="Hope synopsis" />

===Hope for the Republic===
{{Quote|It was a battle they could not win, and if I had arrived before they launched the attack I would have counseled them to hold back. In retrospect, though, it was the courage and selflessness of those men that changed everything that day.|Grand Master Satele Shan recounts the efforts of the Republic Army at the Battle of Alderaan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
Captain [[Jace Malcom]] of Havoc Squad led his forces into position on a ridge overlooking the forest route through the Juran region that was to be traversed by Malgus's [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. As the Imperials marched past the Republic's position, the trooper commander opened fire with a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], initiating the ambush. The rest of Havoc Squad leapt down from the ridge to join their captain in battle against the Sith through the forests of Alderaan. The troopers were able to destroy a number of Mark I Imperial [[Battle droid/Legends|assault droids]] with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, but were eventually engaged by Darth Malgus himself. Upon seeing the Sith Lord [[Shiak|impale]] one of his comrades, Captain Malcom took aim at Malgus, though his first several shots were ineffective. The captain's final cannon blast engulfed the Imperial commander in flames, badly damaging his face. When Malcom attempted to rush the Sith Lord and finish him off, Malgus assaulted him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] him across the battlefield.<ref name="Hope" />

The remaining Sith forces gained the upper hand in the skirmish, eventually forcing the Republic soldiers on the defensive. Havoc Squad troopers that fell behind were systematically [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the Sith<ref name="Hope" /> until intervention from Satele Shan, who had raced to Malcom's aid after contacting the Jedi Council.<ref name="Annihilation" /> The Jedi Knight allowed Havoc Squad the opportunity to press their attack once more while she engaged [[Sith Warrior]]s, their war [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and Malgus himself. Shan and the Sith Lord's fierce melee was nearly ended when Malgus [[Sun djem/Legends|disarmed]] his opponent and attempted to stab her with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The attack was unsuccessful, however, as Shan was able to [[Tutaminis|absorb the energy]] from Malgus's lightsaber, essentially catching the blade with her own hands. While the Sith Lord attempted to penetrate the Jedi's defenses, he was tackled once again by Captain Malcom, who had recovered from their earlier scuffle. While the two grappled with one another, the Havoc Squad captain activated a handheld [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]], sparking a blast that threw both combatants apart and grievously injured both.<ref name="Hope" />

[[File:MalgusSateleHope.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Satele Shan and Darth Malgus duel while the forest battle rages around them.]]
Malcom was rendered unconscious, though Malgus quickly recovered. Despite surviving the explosion, the Sith Lord was again assaulted by Shan, who threw him with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] into a large rock face. As the Sith Lord struggled against her telekinetic attack, the Jedi mustered strength through the Force and delivered a powerful Force Wave, impacting him and shattering the rock around him. With the Imperial commander incapacitated, Republic forces continued to wipe out the Sith forces both in the forest battle and across the rest of Alderaan. Malcom later recovered to find the Imperials defeated, along with many of his own men. Upon being joined by his savior Shan, the commander fired a [[Flare/Legends|signal flare]] into the sky to indicate the Republic victory. The flare was matched by dozens of others across the planet that were immediately followed by the arrival of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], which had returned from addressing Malgus's diversion.<ref name="Hope" />

The return of the Republic Navy prompted the surviving Sith invaders to initiate a full retreat from the Alderaan theater. The seriously wounded Darth Malgus was rescued from the battlefield by his subordinates<ref name="Third Lesson" /> and possibly the bounty hunter Shae Vizla,<ref name="JoMGD" /> and loaded into his [[Darth Malgus's personal shuttle|personal shuttle]], bound for safer regions. While the Sith Lord recovered in his escaping vessel, he felt the presence of a Jedi in the ruins of a township destroyed by the orbital bombardment. Furious over the failure of his invasion, Malgus was determined to take the life of the Jedi in revenge. The Sith Lord ordered his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to reduce their speed and lower the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] before he jumped from the airborne vessel into the streets of the devastated town. On the surface, Malgus encountered a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Unidentified Zabrak Jedi (Battle of Alderaan)|Jedi]] who had planned a trap for the Sith Lord. When Malgus charged at the Zabrak, the Jedi quickly overwhelmed him by using the Force to crush the Sith beneath the rubble of surrounding buildings. The Imperial commander survived the attack and reciprocated with a flurry of lightsaber strikes that beat the Jedi into a defensive stance. Malgus realized that his target was simply baiting him into an ambush, and so used the Force to discern his plan: there was another Jedi lying in wait, hoping to strike at the Sith while he was distracted. Darth Malgus responded by kicking the Zabrak into a building while seeking out the other Jedi, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Vorin]], and crushing his windpipe. The Zabrak Jedi, angered by the death of his comrade, charged at Malgus in a desperate attempt to finish the Sith. Malgus easily broke the attack with a concentrated blast of Force lightning, driving the Jedi to the ground in pain. The Sith Lord then executed his ruined opponent before rejoining his forces in retreat.<ref name="Third Lesson" />

Despite still maintaining a superior orbital position, the Imperial fleet chose not to engage the newly-arrived Republic naval forces, opting instead to collect their ground forces and flee the system.<ref name="JoMGD" /> With the full might of the Republic Military focused on Alderaan, the Sith were driven from the planet and the royal family was rescued from captivity.<ref name="Alderaan" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Imperial invasion was not forgotten, though. For the first time in history, Alderaan's leaders became a voice for aggressive military action in the Senate.|A HoloNet dossier on Alderaan during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]|<ref name="Alderaan" />}}
Although Alderaan was safe from Imperial aggression for the remainder of the war, the invasion had a profound impact on the once-peaceful planet. Alderaan's leaders, who had previously been renowned for their pacifism, began advocating aggressive military operations against the Empire in the Republic's Senate, as a response to the damage the Sith had inflicted on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Alderaan" /> This advocacy, combined with the morale boost from Havoc Squad's victory in the Alderaanian forests, motivated the Republic Military to rally for the next several years. This momentum resulted in victories in the Mid Rim and the [[Minos Cluster Campaign|long-embattled]] [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] in the distant Outer Rim.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Jace Malcom was promoted to the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] in the aftermath of the victory at Alderaan,<ref name="Annihilation" /> and, in addition to working with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Elin Garza]] to expand the Special Forces Division,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> he began leading campaigns against the Empire. Malcom and Shan also began a secret romantic relationship in the days after the battle, though she eventually broke it off six months later during one of [[Campaign near Gell Mattar|Malcom's campaigns]] when she learned she was pregnant with [[Theron Shan|their child]] and confronted Malcom about the darkness in his spirit.<ref name="Annihilation" />

However, the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] [[3665 BBY|two years]] later broke the Republic's recent string of victories, giving the Empire back the advantage but bringing the war to a relative standstill as the Empire struggled to make headway against Republic resistance.<ref name="The Battle of Hoth">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Battle of Hoth}}</ref> In [[3654 BBY]],<ref name="TreatyP">This date is extrapolated from [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], which indicates that the peace agreement was proposed one year prior to its ratification. According to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was implemented in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> the Dark Council was growing increasingly desperate for an end to the war, particularly after the debacle on Alderaan and the loss of a [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="Timeline 2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref> Thusly, the Council called for a [[Alderaan peace conference|peace summit]] to convene so that delegates from both governments might agree on a cession of hostilities. Alderaan was chosen as the meeting place between the two, but ultimately ended up being little more than a distraction from the true endgame: the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> The Sith attack on the Republic capital and the summit on Alderaan ultimately yielded a peace agreement known as the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]—a document that later had severe consequences for the galaxy at large, and Alderaan in particular.<ref name="Alderaan" />

[[File:RepublicReinforcements-TORHope.png|thumb|right|270px|Republic naval forces arrive to retake Alderaan.]]
By all measures, the Sith had won the Great Galactic War, and the Treaty of Coruscant was little more than a concession of defeat for the Republic. The agreement was heavily biased toward Imperial interests<ref name="Timeline 1" />—a fact that outraged Alderaanian politicians who had taken a hardline stance against the Sith in the aftermath of the Battle of Alderaan. In protest of the Republic's establishment of peace with the enemy, [[Gaul Panteer]],<ref name="Bouris Ulgo">{{HolonetOld|biographies|bouris-ulgo|Bouris Ulgo}}</ref> the [[Prince/Legends|Crown Prince]] and [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Alderaan, stormed out of the Senate and declared his planet an independent [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The secession was met with mixed reaction from the people of Alderaan,<ref name="Alderaan" /> particularly in light of the fact that many had expected their world to return to its peaceful ways. [[Bouris Ulgo]] of [[House Ulgo]], a decorated Republic general and former leader of Alderaan's security forces, was dismayed to learn that the Alderaanian military would remain on high alert indefinitely, and that he would not be permitted to return to his farming estates while the nobles played politics.<ref name="BourisCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bouris Ulgo}}</ref>

The situation erupted into chaos following Panteer's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Queen Silara Panteer, a survivor of Imperial imprisonment during the battle, died in the following days, leaving the Alderaanian throne vacant and the [[Alderaanian Parliament]] unable to appoint a new ruling family.<ref name="Alderaan" /> It was at this point that the Empire made a new bid for Alderaan—this time by manipulating the return of the outcast noble [[House of Thul|House Thul]].<ref name="Thul">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Thul}}</ref> The reappearance of House Thul, which was now little more than an Imperial puppet family, prompted Bouris Ulgo to declare himself [[King/Legends|King]] and demand the obedience of the other houses. Although the patriot Ulgo was attempting to prevent what he saw as a new Imperial invasion, his fellow nobles were repulsed by his institution of martial law and execution of the remaining members of House Panteer.<ref name="BourisCodex" /> As the usurping House Ulgo, the Imperial-allied Thuls, and the Republic-backed Organas competed to become the new royal family, Alderaan fell back into violence and tyranny. Over the next decade, Republic and Imperial combatants flocked to the world to attempt to influence the outcome of what became [[Alderaan Civil War|one of the bloodiest planetary civil wars]] in [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]].<ref name="Alderaan" />

During this period, the [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|personal journal]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] was reviewed and entered into the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Gnost-Dural had been aboard the Republic fleet that arrived to retake Alderaan, and as such, was able to contribute a personal point of view on the battle. However, due to his distant position from the fighting on the ground, he was unable to accurately describe the conflict's progress. This gap in information prompted then–Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Satele Shan to add an annotation to the section of the journal to detail her involvement, as well as the efforts of Havoc Squad.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Alderaan was created as a background event for [[LucasArts]]' and [[BioWare]]'s massively-multiplayer online [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The battle was first mentioned on the [http://www.swtor.com/info/holonet/planets/alderaan Alderaan page] of [[the Holonet]], an online feature available on [http://www.swtor.com ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} official website]. The Holonet is intended to provide information regarding the history of the galaxy prior to the game's starting point. Concerning the Battle of Alderaan, the Holonet explains the reasons for the Alderaanian civil war found in the game.<ref name="Holonet Alderaan">{{HolonetOld|planets|alderaan|Alderaan}}</ref>

Information on the battle was expanded upon with the release of [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'']], the second cinematic trailer for ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' released on [[June 14]], [[2010]]. The trailer revealed that Havoc Squad and the Jedi Order were involved in the battle, as well as Darth Malgus—a character who was first introduced in the [[Deceived|previous cinematic trailer]]. The trailer was narrated by a Havoc Squad captain, Jace Malcom, whose voice actor has yet to be confirmed by official sources. The release of ''Hope'' also confirmed the conflict's name as the "Battle of Alderaan."<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> In [[March]] [[2011]], eight months after ''Hope''{{'s}} release, [[BioWare]] senior creative writer and author of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]'' confirmed via ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} online message boards that the unidentified Jedi female in the trailer is Satele Shan, a prominent character in the game itself.<ref name="Satele Shan">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5637093#edit5637093|text=Alexander Freed's post on SWTOR.com, confirming Satele's appearance in ''Hope''|nolive=1}}</ref>

[[File:ShanThrowsMalgus-JMGD.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Satele's triumph over Malgus, as seen in ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]
Additional information on the battle is provided in ''The Old Republic'' itself, which was released on [[December 20]], 2011. The player character learns the history of the Alderaanian Civil War—including its roots in the Battle of Alderaan—while traversing the planet and engaging in missions for either the Sith Empire or the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], a book released in collector's editions of ''The Old Republic'', included new information on the battle, including Satele Shan's activities prior to Havoc Squad's attack and Gnost-Dural's presence with the navy.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Images of the battle were used as promotional material in anticipation of the game's release, although it should be noted that representations of Darth Malgus in these images presented him with his distinctive jaw covering, which he does not receive until after his injuries at the hands of Satele Shan during the Battle of Alderaan.<ref name="promo">{{Facebook|username=starwarstheoldrepublic|url=photo.php?fbid=10150651236783860&set=a.10150638823268860.404476.28984808859&type=1&theater|text=Battle of Alderaan promotional image}}</ref>

The battle was included in a history of the Great Galactic War found in ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'', published on [[April 30]], [[2012]] and written by [[Ryder Windham]]. However, according to the text, the Battle of Alderaan occurred in conjunction with the Sacking of Coruscant and the Alderaan peace conference—statements in direct conflict with ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'', ''The Old Republic: Deceived'', and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]''. Additionally, this placement is made impossible by Darth Malgus's participation in both conflicts. The 2012 novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' revealed that Shan and Malcom began a relationship following the battle that resulted in the birth of her son Theron, but the book incorrectly places the battle in the year [[3670 BBY]].
